invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is likely required to identify the write/commit being performed.
records should not be null to perform an insert/overwrite operation.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is essential for executing write operations.
records.size() must be non-negative, and if records is empty, this is always true; this checks structural property of List.
instantTime should not be blank, as a valid commit instant is usually required.
